title: Finite integrability of monomials
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p$ be a positive integer, and let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space. If $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ are mutually independent real random variables in $L^p$, then for every subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}X_i$ belongs to $L^p$.
hypotheses_covered: the random variables are mutually independent
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
